What Aehr Test Systems says to expect

  • Fiscal 2027: revenueBased on our first quarter performance, substantial backlog, and visibility into customer production requirements, we are raising our fiscal 2027 revenue outlook to $150 million, compared with our previous guidance range of $130 million to $150 million.
